title: Kinetic Poster
line: A loud poster: giant black type slammed on signal yellow, one cobalt, whips on the beat.
line_zh: 一张响亮的海报：信号黄上猛砸的巨大黑字，一抹钴蓝，踩点甩镜。
prompt: Kinetic poster style: giant heavy black type slammed onto signal yellow, one cobalt accent, scale-slam and weight-morph type with a small overshoot, whip and scale-punch transitions, a hype house bed with punches and a kick on every card.
prompt_zh: 动态海报风格：信号黄底上猛砸的巨大粗黑字，一抹钴蓝，缩放重击与字重变化字效带小幅回弹，甩镜与缩放冲击转场，热烈的浩室配乐，每张卡配重拳与底鼓。
essence: Type is the image and it is loud: one word fills the frame, lands on the beat and moves on. Everything else is cut away.

not.difference: Swiss Grid is quiet black on white with no overshoot; Kinetic Poster is loud, saturated and slams.
Neon Night glows on a dark ground; Kinetic Poster is flat ink on a bright ground.

palette.logic: signal yellow ground, near-black ink, ONE cobalt for the key word and the button

camera.expresses: the frame hitting on the beat

signature_features.text: near-black ink on signal yellow at 15:1, cobalt at 6.7:1 (contrast.py)
scale-slam and weight-morph type set upper-case
a hype house bed with punches and kicks
one word or line fills the frame at a time
